entities.title: GitHub and GitLab only
entities.summary: Other git hosts can't be read.
entities.impact: A repository on another host can't be opened; a self-hosted GitLab works only if it allows the page's origin.
entities.workaround: Mirror the repository to GitHub or GitLab.

entities.title: 60 GitHub requests an hour without a token
entities.summary: Unauthenticated, GitHub allows 60 API requests an hour per address.
entities.impact: About thirty repositories an hour can be opened from one network before GitHub refuses.
entities.workaround: Add a token, which raises the limit to 5,000.

entities.title: Very large repositories are listed in part
entities.summary: GitHub cuts a large tree short; the GitLab listing stops after 200 pages of 100 files.
entities.impact: Some folders may be missing; the status line says so for GitHub, not for GitLab.
entities.workaround: Open a folder of the repository rather than its root.

entities.title: The filter matches names only
entities.summary: The tree's filter looks at folder names, view titles and part names and IDs.
entities.impact: Words in a summary, a description or a record's details are not found.

entities.title: Long names crowd the tree
entities.summary: A folder's kind icons sit beside its name in a 290 px column.
entities.impact: A folder with many kinds of view leaves its name little room, and a long name breaks over several lines.

entities.title: One kind of view at a time
entities.summary: Two kinds of view in a folder can't be seen side by side.
entities.impact: Comparing, say, a component diagram with the features it carries means switching tabs.

entities.title: The inspector covers the drawing
entities.summary: The inspector is a fixed panel at the right, over the page.
entities.impact: On a 15-inch screen its 380 px cover about a third of the content area beside the folder column, and whatever part of the drawing is under it. It does not take the focus, so a keyboard reader doesn't land in it.

entities.title: Large monitors are not put to use
entities.summary: The page was not laid out for 27-inch and wider screens.
entities.impact: On a 27-inch or 34-inch monitor most of the width is empty: a drawing is fitted at no more than 100%, so it keeps its natural size in a wide frame; cards stop at 940 px and descriptions at 76 characters; the folder column stays 290 px; and only one kind of view shows at a time.

entities.title: A selection is not in the address
entities.summary: Selecting a part with the pointer does not change the address.
entities.impact: To link to a part, the reader has to write the |kind:part form themselves.

entities.title: One line for every problem
entities.summary: Skipped files are listed in the one status line.
entities.impact: With many unreadable files the line becomes a long paragraph at the top of the page.

entities.title: Only simple Markdown
entities.summary: Record details render paragraphs, lists, bold, inline code and links.
entities.impact: Tables, images, italics, block quotes and code blocks show as plain text; headings show as bold lines.

entities.title: Some colours are outside the tokens
entities.summary: The error red and the source-verified green are written into their rules, not tokens.
entities.impact: A change of palette has to find them: #b3261e and #ff8a80 for errors, #2c6e3a and #8fd39d for source-verified, and the shadows.

entities.title: No light or dark switch
entities.summary: The page follows the system's setting.
entities.impact: A reader can't choose dark on a light system or the other way round.

entities.title: English only
entities.summary: Every word on the page is written into the script in English.
entities.impact: The page can't be offered in another language without changing its code.

entities.title: Read only
entities.summary: The browser can't change a .dev file.
entities.impact: A reader who finds a mistake has to ask an agent, or edit the repository, elsewhere.
